name: UniOne
line: Hosted email delivery for newsletters, campaigns and app messages.

free.text: Free test sending, up to 100/day to verified or confirmed addresses

cells.newsletters: Yes, for opted-in and confirmed recipients

subs.math: 4,000 emails fit inside the 6,000-email plan. The price applies after the four-month trial.
40,000 emails fit the next published tier, 50,000 emails a month.
200,000 emails fit the 300,000-email tier. The 150K tier plus overage may cost less.

appmail.math: 3,000 app emails fit inside the 6,000-email plan. The price applies after the four-month trial.
